## Problem 1

```{r}
alpha <- 0.02
t <- (-2.373)
n <- 28
pvalue <- 2 * (1 - pt(abs(t), n - 1))
pvalue
pvalue < alpha
```

## Problem 2

```{r}
energy <- read.csv("./data/energy.csv")
```

### A: Plot Data

```{r}
hist(energy$usage)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(energy, aes(x = usage)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 10)
```

### B: Relevant Variables

```{r}
# Population
mu <- 909
sigma <- 105

# Sample
alpha <- 0.05
xbar <- mean(energy$usage)
n <- length(energy$usage)
s <- sd(energy$usage)

xbar
s
```

### C: Confidence Interval

```{r}
zstar <- 1 - qnorm(1 - alpha)
```



### D: Hypothesis Test

$H_0$: $\mu = 909$

$H_1$: $\mu > 909$

```{r}
alpha <- 0.05

stderr <- sigma / sqrt(n)
z <- (xbar - mu) / stderr
z

pvalue <- 1 - pnorm(z)
pvalue

pvalue < alpha
```
